fields.description: Server-side only. Never sent to the browser — the frontend is a static export and cannot hold a key.
fields.label: OpenRouter API Key

fields.description: Used when the tier above it is blank. The previous default, google/gemini-2.0-flash-001, has been retired from OpenRouter and no longer resolves.
fields.label: Fallback Model

fields.description: The workhorse. Every text-only task routes here. Free ids end in ':free' — current list at https://openrouter.ai/models?max_price=0 . Free endpoints generally require opting in to prompt logging/training, and guest intake and dedupe send household names and phone numbers.
fields.label: Text Model (free tier)

fields.description: Used automatically whenever a photo is attached. Defaults to a free multimodal model so the photo path works before you add credits — swap in a paid one (e.g. google/gemini-3.7-flash or deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp) once you have.
fields.label: Vision Model (photo intake)

fields.description: Used only when a screen explicitly asks to escalate. Deliberately blank — this one costs real money, so nothing bills you until you choose a model. Leave empty and the 'use the smarter model' controls stay hidden. Suggestions: anthropic/claude-opus-5, moonshotai/kimi-k3.
fields.label: Smart Model (complex work)
